name: teleparallel-nr
description: A 1D numerical relativity testbed comparing the Teleparallel Equivalent of General Relativity (TEGR) against BSSN on standard benchmarks (gauge wave, Gowdy wave), built on identical numerical infrastructure. Appears to be the first working numerical evolution code for TEGR. All equations were re-derived and machine-verified symbolically before use; two typos were found in the published literature along the way.
